  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Noni Tree Room</strong></h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong><em>Bright • Breezy • Garden &amp; Mangrove Views</em></strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Located on the second floor of the back building, the Noni Tree Room is one of the newer and more inviting additions to Camp Bay Lodge. With large louvered French doors and windows, this room fills with natural light and steady Caribbean trade winds, creating a soft, breezy atmosphere throughout the day.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The room features a queen bed, a private bathroom finished with handcrafted Honduran tiles and a custom-made sink, and a mini-fridge for added convenience. From this elevated corner of the property, you can enjoy peaceful views of the garden, the mangrove forest, and a side glimpse of the Caribbean Sea.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">A ceiling fan — along with an optional standing fan — ensures comfort on warmer days while still allowing you to enjoy the natural airflow that defines East End living.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Step outside to the shared upper-level deck, where hammocks and seating create a relaxed place to unwind, read, or simply enjoy the quiet rhythm of the surroundings.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Calm, bright, and surrounded by greenery, the Noni Tree Room is well-suited for couples, solo travelers, or small families who appreciate simple comfort and a peaceful place to return to after exploring the beach and slow adventures of Camp Bay.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Refreshing breeze, gentle light, and tranquil views — the Noni Tree Room offers an easy, unhurried stay on Roatán’s quiet East End.</p></div>
